owned_invariants: No float: values are i64 or lists of values; every sum, product, difference and cost is checked and overflow is refused as OVERFLOW.
A colour exists only if the canon lists it under operad_colour or prompt_colour; Colour has no Deserialize.
An operation's arity fits its body, and substitution requires the inner target colour to equal the slot colour.
An opaque operation has no body and is never evaluated (NO_BODY).
boundaries: Bodies are a closed set of seven; anything else is opaque and stays unverified.
Structure equality is equality of normal forms (identity nodes dropped); it is not a decision procedure for arbitrary rewriting.

score.level_basis: Typed refusals on every failure path, closed vocabularies from the canon, checked arithmetic, no unwrap or direct indexing.

basis.G1: Module header declares AuthorityEffect None and the contract URN; public items match this contract and code/rust/pfp_operads/README.md. Not B: no requirement-to-symbol trace beyond the README and docs/plans/operads_redesign.md.
basis.G2: Exact profile: i64 with checked_add/checked_mul/checked_sub on every path, cost in checked u64; overflow and shape errors are refusals and are tested. Not B: bounded integers, no big-integer model.
basis.G3: Every failure is a typed Refusal with a stable code; no unwrap, expect or direct slice index. Not B: panic-freedom is tested, not proven.
basis.G4: 16 law tests exercise construction, substitution, evaluation, cost and normal form, including each refusal code. clippy -D warnings and rustfmt pass. Lexical mutation campaign R = 21/21. Not B: mutants are hand-written one-line edits, not a generated campaign, and there are no generator-driven property tests.
